entries.title: Granite 4.2 30B
entries.summary: Granite 4.2 30B, the flagship dense reasoning model in IBM's open-weight Granite 4.2 family, joins the catalog on one BYOK route.

entries.title: Llamport: four OpenAI GPT models at 10% of the OpenAI price
entries.summary: Llamport is a new upstream on AnyRouter. It serves four OpenAI GPT models at 10% of the OpenAI API list price, on the AnyRouter platform key or with your own Llamport key.
